_comment_c4: Lyonette's hub now ALSO gives + resolves Quest 2 'The Wrong Order'. The give-option ('Something's got you rattled...') is hide_when heard_wrong_order (visible until the quest is heard); the three convergence REPORT options are progress-gated on requires.accomplishment (HIDDEN until the matching path counter is banked -- so they never appear to a player who hasn't done a path, and never touch scripts that don't bank those counters). Only the give-option is always-visible pre-quest, so dialogue_walkthrough's two hub option-asserts were updated to include it (heard_wrong_order is 0 there). 'Maybe later.' remains the always-available softlock exit.
_comment_advice_flow: FUNCTION: barmaid_retort's 'Fair enough. Go on.' carries the SAME bank-lyonette_tip + goto-tip pair as hub's own 'Go on.' -- the two are parallel entries into the tip, one same-visit, one for the asked-then-left-then-came-back path. TRAP: routing barmaid_retort's accept back through hub instead replays the opening line before the tip is ever heard -- reads as the conversation looping/resetting. `tip`'s held-a-line variant gates on requires.class.warrior:2 (the dialogue ctx exposes real class levels; olesm_intro.json's Tactician gate is the same mechanism) because the base line must not assert combat experience a non-Warrior PC lacks. CONSTRAINT: hub's opening line implies she has something worth hearing without labeling it advice -- keep the flag implicit on future copy edits.

hub.speaker: Lyonette
hub.text: If you're headed to the Guild, there's something worth hearing, and it costs you nothing.

text_variants.text: You'll do fine at the Guild - just remember what I told you.
...Don't. Don't say the word 'order' too loudly. If Erin hears of it before it's fixed I will simply die on the spot. Tell me you've sorted it.
There you are. The... supply matter. It's handled, and quietly. I won't forget that you did that.

options.text: Advice about the Guild? From a barmaid?
Something's got you rattled. What is it?
The supplier's scavenger trouble is dealt with - your order's on its way.
I smoothed it over with Krshia. The shortfall's covered.
I stretched the order in the kitchen. No one will know it ran short.

barmaid_retort.speaker: Lyonette
barmaid_retort.text: A barmaid hears everything worth hearing in this city. But fine - go in blind if you prefer.

tip.speaker: Lyonette
tip.text: Selys respects competence, not chatter. Keep your answers short and skip the small talk.

text_variants.text: Selys respects competence, not chatter. Stand like you've held a line before - which, evidently, you have - and skip the small talk.

order_brief.speaker: Lyonette
order_brief.text: I under-counted the week's supply order. I was raised to run a household larger than this inn, and I cannot count a grocery list. Spare me. It's short, and Erin trusts me to run this without her checking. There are three ways to make it right before she notices. The supplier - Krshia's people - has scavengers picking at their stores in the south market; clear that trouble by force and the delivery comes free and full. Or you could smooth it over with Krshia herself; she'll extend the order on a good word. Or - if you can cook - stretch what we have in the kitchen until the shortfall simply... isn't one. Pick whichever suits you. Only be quick.

gratitude.speaker: Lyonette
gratitude.text: It's... done. Truly done. I keep waiting for you to name a price, and you don't. Do you know how strange that is, to me? Where I'm from, no one lifts a finger without a ledger open. — Here. It's what I could scrape together, and no, I'll not hear a word against taking it. Thank you. And not the court kind of thank-you. The real one. Now go sit down before I say something I'll regret.
